queries: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM name_averages), kept AS (SELECT n.event_name, n.avg_amount, o.overall_avg FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT event_name, avg_amount, avg_amount - overall_avg AS difference_from_overall, avg_amount / AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept

WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM name_averages), kept AS (SELECT n.event_name, n.avg_amount, o.overall_avg FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT event_name, avg_amount, avg_amount - overall_avg AS difference_from_overall, avg_amount / AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS overall_average FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.average_budgeted_amount, o.overall_average FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS mean_kept_average FROM kept) SELECT k.event_name, k.average_budgeted_amount, k.average_budgeted_amount - k.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, k.average_budgeted_amount / m.mean_kept_average AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m

WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), compared AS (SELECT event_name, average_amount, AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS overall_average FROM name_averages), kept AS (SELECT event_name, average_amount, overall_average FROM compared WHERE average_amount > overall_average) SELECT event_name, average_amount, average_amount - overall_average AS difference_from_overall, average_amount / AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: A NULL event_name, if present, forms one group. AVG ignores missing amounts; groups with no non-NULL amount cannot pass the above-average filter.

alternatives.interpretation: Only events with a non-NULL name count as event names.
